name: Curse of Violence
body:
Blood, blood is all that sates it.

Bonus Spells: 0th—bleed, 1st—lead blades, 2nd—rage, 3rd—keen edge, 4th—stoneskin

Curse Manifestation

The curse of violence craves bloodshed and ensures that the lathspell is in a position to both inflict and endure it. The lathspell gains a +2 bonus on initiative rolls; however, they take a -2 penalty to AC during the first round of combat. When the lathspell has less than half their normal hit point total, all creatures within 10 feet of the lathspell, including themselves, gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls and a -1 penalty to AC.

Curse Abilities
Brute Strike (Ex)

The lathspell revels in underhanded tactics and close combat. You gain Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat, in addition once per round when you deal more than 10 damage to a creature with a single attack or spell you may make a single unarmed strike as a free action at your highest base attack bonus against a target within 5 feet. At 10th level this unarmed strike may be taken twice per round.

Cruel Entertainment (Ex)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

Lathspells with the curse of violence take delight in causing sustained pain and disabling or humiliating opponents. As a standard action you may make a single attack at your highest attack bonus, if successful you may make a free bull rush, dirty trick, grapple, or trip combat maneuver without provoking an attack of opportunity. If this attack is a critical hit you gain a +5 bonus on the combat maneuver check.

Crazed Opportunist (Su)

Violence is an incredibly reactive curse and grants its lathspell the reflexes to take advantage of any opening. You can make attacks of opportunity while flat-footed and gain a bonus on damage rolls when making attacks of opportunity equal to your Charisma modifier. In addition, if you possess a feat which allows you to make a combat maneuver without provoking an attack of opportunity, you may make such a combat maneuver check in place of an attack of opportunity.

Merciless Follow Through (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

The curse of violence allows the lathspell to charge through foes in order to break their morale.

As a full round action you may choose a single creature within 60 feet, then make a single attack roll and compare it to the AC of each enemy along a straight path between yourself and the target. As long as your attack roll would hit each enemy along the path you may move adjacent to the targeted creature without provoking any attacks of opportunity, then the target must make a Will save with a DC equal to the lathspell’s curse DC +1 for each enemy dealt damage with this attack. Failure means they are stunned with fear for one round.

On success the creature is shaken for one round.

You end your movement from this ability adjacent to the last target in the line hit by this ability.

Ragged Wounds (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

The curse of violence sometimes lashes out and leaves lasting scars. Whenever you deal damage to an opponent with two or more attacks in a single round that opponent must make a Fortitude save vs. the lathspell’s curse DC. For each attack beyond the second which hits the opponent, the save DC increases by +2. On a failed save the creature cannot benefit from magical healing until they have rested for 8 hours, as a fragment of your curse lingers in the wound.

Sadistic Urge (Ex)

Lathspells who carry a curse of violence are filled with an energy that wishes to lash out and destroy. In any round in which you have dealt or received 5 or more damage you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for your next attack or +1 to the save DC of the next spell you cast within one minute. For every 5 damage you deal or receive these bonuses increase by +1 to a maximum of 1/4th of your class level.

For example, at 8th level if you take the full attack action and deal 10 damage with your first attack your second attack would gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls. Conversely if you are 8th level and an enemy deals 15 damage to you with a single attack, on your turn if you were to cast bestow curse on that creature the save DC would be increased by +2, since the total bonus is limited to 1/4 your class level.

Tribute to Bloodshed (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

Violence demands constant tribute. As a standard action you can cause the battle to grow more volatile, all creatures within 30 ft. of you, including yourself, increase the critical threat range of their attacks by 1 and increase the base damage of weapon attacks they possess by one step as though they had increased by one size category, these effects last until the end of your next turn.

Taste for Blood (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

The sustenance for violence is bloodshed. As a standard action you may make a single attack at your highest base attack bonus. Any damage dealt by this attack, before any damage reduction or resistances possessed by the target, heal you for an equal amount. This ability does not include precision damage, but does include additional damage from critical hits. If you possess the Vital Strike feat this ability may be used with that feat as well as Improved Vital Strike and Greater Vital Strike. This ability may be used a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier. The hit points restored by this ability are a result of violent energy being absorbed by your curse and you may benefit from this healing even against bloodless foes.

Reckoning Blade (Su)

The lathspell’s curse extends into their weapon (including their unarmed strikes). As a standard action the lathspell can grant a weapon they are wielding a +1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls for one minute.

At 5th level and every 4 levels beyond 5th level this bonus increases by +1 to a maximum of +5 at level 17. The lathspell may also grant the weapon any of the following special weapon qualities in place of an equivalent bonus: brawling, brilliant energy, dancing, defending, flaming, frost, shock, keen, seeking, vicious, vorpal. Abilities can only be added to a weapon that has a +1 enhancement bonus.

And the lathspell may first apply a +1 bonus before applying abilities to the weapon.

Vicious Backswing (Ex)

When you fail to draw blood, you are still able to throw your opponents off balance. Whenever you take the full attack action and attack a creature but fail to damage them due to DR (or hardness) or fail to beat their AC by two or less you may choose to forgo your next iterative attack to instead knock that creature off balance, bestowing a -2 penalty to their armor class until their next turn. Then you may complete any attacks you have remaining for the round.

Walking Curse
Herald of Battle (Su)

When the curse of violence reaches its zenith the lathspell is a terrifying enemy to behold. They gain a frightful presence, as the universal monster ability, with a radius of 60 feet and a save DC equal to their lathspell curse DC. In addition they gain DR 10/

and any weapons (including ranged weapons and unarmed strikes) they wield gain the vicious special weapon property, even if that weapon could not otherwise gain the vicious property.
